g.text: Neutral arrangement; CAD coordinates in mm. Not a manufacturing drawing or geometry acceptance.
CFRP: dark; PETG: blue; adhesive: magenta; pads: grey; non-mass rotor/yoke references: dashed orange.
Actual edges sampled at 24 points; no hidden-line removal. Geometry and materials remain hypotheses.
Drawing omissions: 10. Consult drawing_diagnostics_01.json; omitted edges are not repaired or concealed.
Rotor diameter hypothesis 279.4 mm; foot socket radius 400 mm; ring attachment Z=430 mm.
Missing: moving carriers, bearings, actuators, equipment, fasteners and qualified retention. No complete-vehicle mass claim.
